text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: This is also thanks to training on a schedule that was put together so flawlessly.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Results naturally follow a flawless plan...
All our faith and hard work were truly worth it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "Without delay, let's put together a schedule for our next race."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I will win next time too, with a flawless plan...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, we mustn't let this make us complacent,
we must aim for even greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "This victory is, so to speak, just one stepping stone on the way to a much greater goal..."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
To steadily keep winning from here on out,
I intend to devote myself even further.
